propositions: When structured parsing exhausts OUTPUT_RETRIES in _pai_structured's prompted reask loop, the raw reply text is discarded and the failure is not replayable.

A new optional config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir enables opt-in capture of final-attempt raw replies (model id, contract name, attempt count) to local timestamped files before raising the parse error.
The parse_failure_artifact_dir field must be added to LLMConfig and resolved via _llm_str in from_env using the RESERVED llm section, not core config.py.
Artifact writes are best-effort and local-only: missing directories are created, unwritable paths do not mask the original error, and old artifacts are pruned to keep at most 20 by mtime.
Key unset (the default) produces byte-for-byte identical behavior to today and writes no artifacts.
